product: French Road Signs in Ukrainian: A Visual Vocabulary Atlas
buyer: Ukrainian-speaking learner or licensed driver in France
jtbd: decode French road signs and high-friction road/exam vocabulary without translating a full French manual
promise: Recognize the sign, understand the French term, and know the required action in plain Ukrainian
differentiation: A sign-first bilingual visual atlas and recall system, not a prose Code de la route summary or copied question bank
paid_value_layer: portable curated visual decoding, false-friend warnings, action language, spaced review and refresh guidance
format: 120-page standard-color 8.5x11 paperback and reflowable Kindle companion
optimal_product_scale: 100-130 pages; approximately 8,000-12,000 words; 120-160 original/licensed sign visuals
content_architecture: how to read French sign families
source_model: current consolidated Code de la route and 1967 signaling order on Legifrance
rights_model: Use legal facts and independently drawn diagrams from regulatory specifications; reuse only assets carrying explicit Open Licence terms with source/date attribution. Do not copy competitor text, proprietary question banks, or Bayard-partner illustrations.
language_qa_model: Automated Ukrainian consistency pass followed by Anton's bounded 30-minute review of title, TOC, 12 representative pages and metadata; French source terms mechanically cross-checked
author_strategy: Neutral imprint/pseudonym with no invented driving-instructor, legal, government or immigration credentials; explicit independent-study-aid disclaimer
kill_conditions: explicit asset reuse rights cannot be confirmed
